title: Recover concurrent daily-sync publication
scope: Keep fetched data commits recoverable; reconcile independent main pushes safely, refuse conflicts without discarding source history, and test publication ordering.
summary: Independent concurrent main changes reconcile losslessly; conflicts and retry exhaustion retain recoverable bundles. Genuine scheduled changed-content publication remains separate.

evidence.result: Exact bounded implementation/source-follow-up scope; earlier reviews, replies and CPIN text unchanged.
421 Python, 366 JavaScript, 99 disposable account checks; nine source-use follow-ups with explicit limits.
Successful publication and 38 anonymous live checks. Not a physical-device, signed-in cross-device or scheduled changed-content check.
